title: Review timeout is a hardcoded 30min with no operator knob (CAM_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS never reaches the review path)
description: A review of a large branch cannot complete and there is no way to raise the ceiling. CAM_WORKER_TIMEOUT_MS is read in exactly one place, src/supervisor/host.ts:835, which serves the implementer/host path. The sidecar phase:review path does not go through it: makeProductionReviewPhaseFn (src/commands/sidecar.ts:1579) constructs makeReviewDispatch WITHOUT passing timeoutMs, so review.ts:393 falls back to DEFAULT_REVIEW_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000 (review.ts:356), a compile-time constant. Observed live 2026-08-10 on branch cam/issue-516 (43 commits, 37 files, 4287 insertions): the reviewer was alive and emitting output continuously for the full 30 minutes (a pane-hash watcher recorded max silence gap of 0s across the whole window) and was then guillotined mid-review, producing review-timeout dispatch failed (pane-pid-after-empty) and no verdict. The env override was set to 5400000 and was inert. Round was not counted, so the loop simply cannot converge on a branch of that size. Same defect family as CAM-511/523/525: the knob exists and documents itself but is not wired to one of its two paths. Fix: thread the same operator knob into the review dispatch; consider a single resolution helper so a third path cannot be added unwired.
